name: 2 x 4! -Hitotsu Yane no Shita de-
source:
Main character attends a cooking school and lives in a boarding house. Next to him there are rooms of a prank-lover girl, a loli cosplay maniac and a cute owner girl who loves sweets.

Laughter sounds there all day long. Can protagonist find his love there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
